_comment: Vann's own brain: a small model on this laptop (through Ollama, as MoJo and Jarvis use it) that sits between Gemini and the simple brain. Gemini plans; this picks the moment-to-moment moves by Gemini's orders; the simple brain covers everything else (fights, danger, travel already under way, conversations).
_model_comment: Any Ollama chat model. qwen2.5:1.5b (about 1 GB) is light enough to run beside the game on this laptop and still follows instructions; llama3.2:1b is lighter still, qwen2.5:3b smarter but heavier. The launcher pulls it the first time.
_every_comment: At most one choice from this brain every so many seconds; the simple brain decides in between.
_escalate_comment: The simple brain keeps him moving while this one thinks. A question it hasn't answered in this many seconds goes up to Gemini instead (if the character has Gemini time left).
_knowledge_comment: How much of knowledge/*.md rides in its prompt. Small models do better with less.
